most_similar_reason: Candidate 7 tells essentially the same story: a sibling-spouse goddess whose brother-husband king, child of earth and sky deities, is murdered and dismembered by a jealous brother, whose scattered pieces she and her sister gather and reassemble, reviving him with magic long enough to conceive the son who later avenges him and takes the throne, after which the murdered king dwells in the underworld.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 10 is a loose anthology of trickster creation and prank tales with no murdered fertility king, no dismemberment or reassembly, no avenging son, and no rule over the dead.
